summary: Follow-ups from review 13: e08ab60 (a party's 'You were just in' record stays with the profile that joined it; a failed first read of the rooms is said beside a room made meanwhile; a Join button's record survives a window blur; af0ecbf9: clean) and 2d0f93a (a Settings row knows its own last write; the quiet, danger and toggled ghost hovers skip disabled buttons; layout-effect refs; a8ce3c17: clean). Nits left: a list reorder can drop focus; a room made while the first read is out can vanish until the next read; the 'already saved from this device' wording can be wrong when another device sets the same limit.
